title: Hera Syndulla
description: Hera Syndulla was one of the early Rebels against the Galactic Empire. The Twi'lek piloted the ship known as The Ghost. Her best friend, Kanan Jarrus, was the former Jedi Padawan Caleb Dume. When Kanan was apprehended by the Empire, Chopper located the Star Destroyer and Hera led the mission to infiltrate the warship and free him. Unfortunately, this was not the end of their struggles against the Empire, only the beginning.
